notes.title: Dream Rhythm on sale ！
notes.content:
After much effort, Dream Rhythm is finally officially launched. We welcome friends who have been following us to come and experience it. 

We also welcome our fellow enthusiasts to join our group and provide valuable feedback, which will be helpful for the production and updates of our future works.
